issue: pórḱos gʷétes: gʷétes is 2sg imperfect ('you said'); 3sg subject needs gʷétet.

Schleicher's 1868 text in his own notation (awis, yasmin warnā na ā ast, dadarka akwams, wāgʰam, bʰarantam...). The a-vocalism, missing laryngeals and accents, acc. pl. -ms and augment ā are all outdated. Fine as a historical document, not as corpus PIE; it needs a separate label or a modern form.
tósyo-kʷe ḱérdih₁ kénketi: ḱérdih₁ is the nom./acc. dual of ḱḗr. 'His heart' (sg., with a sg. verb) needs nom. sg. ḱḗr.

ml̥dúes: nom. pl. of a proterokinetic u-adjective should be ml̥déwes (Ved. mṛdávaḥ); this is an engine table error. Coordination 'X-kʷe Y-kʷe Z' / 'X-kʷe Y' puts -kʷe on the wrong conjuncts (expected X Y-kʷe, or X-kʷe Y-kʷe). wé for nom. du. 'we two' is usually *wéh₁.
séh₂ wókʷet 'she said': wókʷeti, an o-grade thematic present, rests only on Gmc. *gawahwaną 'mention'. The standard verb is *wékʷti / aor. *wéwkʷet, which this corpus uses elsewhere as wéwket.

Schleicher's 1868 text (akwāsas ā wawakant, krudʰi awai, kard agʰnutai...) in pre-laryngeal a-vocalism notation. It is outdated as PIE. There is also a transcription artifact, 'wiwidwant- swas' (Schleicher has vividvant-svas).

yugóm wéwket. tóh₁ yunégti: 3sg yunégti for 'I join'; it should be 1sg yunégmi. Lesser point: déwkmi/déwkti are athematic, but *dewk- is thematic in the daughter languages (Lat. dūcō, Goth. tiuhan), so *déwkoh₂/déwketi.
wókʷet 'said' (twice): weakly founded o-grade thematic present (Gmc.-only *gawahwaną). Otherwise good.

Scholarly (Byrd 2013 ending of Schleicher's fable). It departs from corpus conventions: bʰuged is unaccented and spelled with -d (thematic aorist bʰugét); h₂aǵróm has a-vocalism and oxytone accent where the corpus uses h₂éǵrom. Masc. participle ḱeḱluwṓs is used with h₂ówis, which is usually feminine (fem. ḱeḱlusih₂).

ǵʰémi: the loc. of dʰéǵʰōm is normally *dʰǵʰém(i) (Ved. kṣámi); the initial dʰ is dropped (engine loc_sg spec). Root-aorist drémt/dr̥mént is acceptable, though Gk. édramon points to a thematic aorist.
ḱl̥wónts: the zero grade of *ḱlew- before a vowel is ḱluw-, so the participle should be ḱluwónts; *ḱl̥w- is ill-formed (engine PTCP.ACT error).
nu stéygʰome sḿ̥teros dréwi: stéygʰome is a 1pl thematic imperfect ('we walked'). 'One of the two climbed' needs 3sg aorist stéygʰt.

Neuter tód (and the neuter predicate ish₁róm) is used for h₁yégos 'ice', which this text treats as masc. elsewhere (o-stem loc. h₁yégoy, tósmi). Fix 'gʷémt márkos tód' → tóm, 'tód ish₁róm ne h₁ésti' and 'tód-kʷe ish₁róm h₁ésti' → só ish₁rós, and 'bʰidtó-kʷe tód ish₁róm Hn̥dʰí' → só (ish₁róm Hn̥dʰí is correct). This is a repeated agreement error; the meaning is still recoverable.
tód péruti píph₃es 'last year you drank it': the referent is h₂ékʷeh₂ (fem.), so expect tā́m. Neuter tód is just about defensible as 'that'.

nu h₁ógʷʰih₁ tóns spéḱyet: h₁ógʷʰih₁ is nom. dual ('two serpents'). 'A serpent' with a sg. verb needs h₁ógʷʰis. Lesser point: abl. pl. gʷéwbʰos has an e-grade where Ved. góbhyas and Lat. bōbus point to *gʷówbʰos.
tód tinéh₁ti 'the ice is melting': neuter tód for masc. h₁yégos (expect só). wókʷet 'said' is the weakly founded o-grade present.
